versions.changelog:
**Summary: Extended skill guidance and removed sample files.**

- Added comprehensive project workflow and task classification guidance to SKILL.md.
- Expanded references for project structure, debugging, build/signing, and troubleshooting real HarmonyOS repositories.
- Kept core developer quick reference and API usage from previous version.
- Removed redundant files: _meta.json and skill-card.md.

HarmonyOS Developer Skills

A comprehensive skill set for building HarmonyOS applications using ArkTS and ArkUI.

Topics covered:
- Development environment setup (DevEco Studio, SDK)
- ArkUI components and layouts (Text, Image, Button, Column, Row, List, Grid, etc.)
- State management (@State, @Prop, @Link, @Observed)
- Component lifecycle
- Routing and navigation
- Network requests (@ohos.net.http)
- Local storage (@ohos.data.preferences)
- Permissions and user authorization
- Build and signing configuration

Perfect for developing apps for HarmonyOS Next and OpenHarmony devices.
